headline: Approved Salem High School's February 2028 Dominican Republic trip, 7-0, after it was pulled from the consent agenda.
summary: The meeting included public comment on the school calendar and classroom screen time. Members also heard a presentation on MCAS and ACCESS results and a finance update. Members approved the Dominican Republic trip and the other consent agenda items.
decisions: Approved the revised consent agenda, including the September 22, 2026 minutes, the SkillsUSA trip, and the warrants, 7-0.
Approved the Salem High School trip to the Dominican Republic for February 2028, 7-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to Approve Revised Consent Agenda (excluding Dominican Republic trip): Moved by: Member Manning | Seconded by: Member Cornell Vote (Roll Call): Member Manning: Yes; Member Miranda: Yes; Member Stot: Yes; Member Byas: Yes; Member Cornell: Yes; Member Hoffman: Yes; Chair: Yes. Motion passed 7-0.

Motion: To approve the Salem High School EF field trip to the Dominican Republic for February 2028. Moved by: Member Cornell | Seconded by: Member Hoffman Vote (Roll Call): Member Hoffman: Yes; Member Manning: Yes; Member Miranda: Yes; Member Stot: Yes; Member Byas: Yes; Member Cornell: Yes; Chair: Yes. Motion passed 7-0.
